public.text: “Orchestrates national-level data” is used to describe non-transactional infrastructure. Orchestration normally implies active coordination of transactions or workflows, making the description internally contradictory.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with phrase liek: “maintains or provides shared data, reference information, or reusable services to operational systems.” Reserve “orchestration” for components that genuinely coordinate transactions.
